query: WITH scope_tracks(track_id) AS ( SELECT entity_id FROM user_library WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'track' UNION SELECT entity_id FROM user_feedback WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'track' AND value = 'like' UNION SELECT pt.track_id FROM playlist_tracks pt JOIN playlists p ON p.id = pt.playlist_id WHERE p.owner_user_id = ? AND p.is_temporary = 0 UNION SELECT mf.track_id FROM media_files mf JOIN library_folders lf ON lf.id = mf.folder_id WHERE mf.storage = 'folder' AND lf.owner_user_id = ? ) SELECT al.id FROM search_fts JOIN albums al ON al.rowid = search_fts.rowid / 4 WHERE search_fts MATCH ? AND search_fts.rowid % 4 = 2 AND (al.id IN (SELECT t.album_id FROM tracks t JOIN scope_tracks st ON st.track_id = t.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_library WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'album' AND entity_id = al.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_feedback WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'album' AND value = 'like' AND entity_id = al.id)) ORDER BY rank LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
